(a stack, 790-791; unblessing makes bknown known, 813). She sells a wished cursed potion of water two squares south, walks back north and zaps south through both piles: 'You uncurse that, you pay for it!'. 822-823 (the hero off a costly square) are not reached: the square she zaps from counts as costly.
